test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following websites is NOT related to Education?
solution:
The correct answer is__** www.onlinesbi.com.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **www.onlinesbi.com** is the official website of the State Bank of India (SBI) for online banking services.
 
• The other three websites are directly related to educational resources and institutions in India.
 
• State Bank of India (SBI): SBI is a multinational public sector bank in India, offering various financial services, including personal and corporate banking.
 
• Online Banking: SBI's online banking platform allows users to access their accounts, make transactions, and manage financial services conveniently through the internet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• www.ignou.ac.in: This is the official website of the Indira Gandhi National Open University, offering distance learning programs.
 
• www.ncert.nic.in: This site belongs to the National Council of Educational Research and Training, which publishes textbooks and educational resources for schools.
 
• www.education.nic.in: This is the Ministry of Education's official website, providing information on educational policies and programs in India.
 
• **Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU)**: Established in 1985, IGNOU is one of the largest open universities in the world, providing distance education across various disciplines.
 
• **National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)**: Founded in 1961, NCERT focuses on improving the quality of education in schools and develops textbooks and teaching materials.
 
• **Ministry of Education**: The Ministry oversees the implementation of educational policies, frameworks, and various programs aimed at enhancing education in India.
